overall_assessment: Heading-based extraction works well for UiA: learning outcomes keep all three competence groups, 'Vilkår for å gå opp til eksamen' goes to coursework_requirements, and the boilerplate/empty pre-pass flags are false alarms (identical practice-course texts, legitimately short sections). Remaining issues are the unmapped 'Faget i praksis' heading being appended to the previous section, five plans that contain no body content at all, and minor attendance/admission text in the wrong section.

findings.evidence: Hvert semester har studenten ett eller flere fokusfag.
findings.description: The sub-section 'Faget i praksis' (placement description) has no canonical section. It is appended to the preceding section: to learning_outcomes in all PRA practice courses (after Generell kompetanse), and to course_content in MA, IDR, NO, SV, PED courses. Learning outcomes then contain non-outcome prose, and course_content contains placement logistics.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/section_heading_map.R has no pattern for 'Faget i praksis', so the splitter does not cut there and the text is glued onto the previous section.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a pattern for '^Faget i praksis$' in R/section_heading_map.R that starts a new (discarded or teaching_methods) block, placed before the learning_outcomes/course_content patterns so it terminates them.

findings.description: Five courses (EN-156, NAT115, PED426, ERN401, REL126, all 2023 autumn) have no sections at all. The course_plan text holds only the header, study programme list and credit-reduction table; Læringsutbytte, Innhold, Eksamen etc. are absent, so the extractor has nothing to split. Real course content was lost before section extraction.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Upstream harvest/fulltext capture for these pages returned only the page shell (content accordions not rendered or selector missed them), not a sections-splitter defect.
findings.suggested_fix: Re-fetch these 2023-autumn plans and inspect the HTML; fix selector or year-specific structure in R/institution_config.R (uia). Exclude courses whose plan lacks 'Læringsutbytte' from the section dataset or flag them as no-content.

findings.evidence: For enkeltemnestudenter: fullført lærerutdanning rettet inn mot grunnskolen/videregående opplæring.
findings.description: The 'Opptakskrav hvis tilbudt som enkeltemne' admission text is appended to prerequisites. This is an admission requirement for stand-alone students, not a course prerequisite; in MA-172 it is the only prerequisites content.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Heading 'Opptakskrav ...' is mapped to prerequisites in R/section_heading_map.R (matches 'opptakskrav').
findings.suggested_fix: Narrow the prerequisites pattern so 'Opptakskrav hvis/om tilbudt som enkeltemne' is not matched (map to a discarded block).

findings.evidence: Det er krav om minimum 70 % obligatorisk deltagelse i undervisningen.
findings.description: Mandatory-attendance requirements embedded in body text stay in teaching_methods (70 % in MA/PED courses), and in PRA courses 'Det er krav om 100 % tilstedeværelse i praksis' stays in assessment. These pass/approve gates belong in coursework_requirements per the codebook. Workload hours also sit in teaching_methods.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Splitting is heading-based only; sentences inside Undervisnings- og læringsformer or Eksamen are not classified.
findings.suggested_fix: Optional sentence-level post-step for uia moving sentences matching 'krav om .*(tilstedeværelse|deltagelse|frammøte)' to coursework_requirements; otherwise document as known limitation.
